messages:
Maria Chen: Quick thread to lock down SI crediting + demo gating rules for the joint marketplace launch next Tue. Need airtight audit trail and a simple partner UX.
Tia Gomez: +1. We're seeing two failure modes: (1) SI runs demo but Redwood never gets pipeline credit; (2) marketplace lead gets demo before legal NDA completes. Need deterministic rules.
Arun Desai: Suggestion: single source-of-truth claim object per account with these fields: acct_id, si_partner, claim_ts, claim_role (pre-demo|post-demo), prior_owner, demo_hold (true|false), audit_notes. Expose CSV export and an API.
Laila Nguyen: On demo gating: add `demo_hold=true` when account has pending MSA/NDA/compliance. Any partner trying to schedule should get a UI modal: "Account under legal review, contact partnerships@redwood."
Samir Patel: For partner commands, minimal, e.g.:
```
/partner-claim --partner="helium-sys" --acct=ACCT-9982 --role=pre-demo --note="referral from marketplace"
/partner-release --acct=ACCT-9982
```
claims-bot: claim-service: new_claim ACCT-9982 status=pending reviewer=null
Maria Chen: Reclaim rules: first-touch owner has 48h to confirm. If prior owner exists and objects, escalate to partnerships lead + AE manager, decision within 24h. No demo until resolution.
Tia Gomez: CSV fields we'd need for reconciliation: acct_id, partner, claim_ts (iso), claim_role, prior_owner, status, demo_hold, last_event_ts, audit_log_url. Put sample CSV export every morning at 6am PT.
Arun Desai: I'll implement webhook that emits a compact JSON line per event and a daily CSV snapshot. Webhook URL: https://hooks.redwood/internal/claims/sync (will be auth'd).
Laila Nguyen: For crediting: SI gets initial credit if they lead discovery and demo and attach meeting recording or meeting notes within 24h. Otherwise, credit reassigns to Redwood AE. We need an evidence flag on claim.
Samir Patel: Auto-rules: if claim.status==pending and now() - claim_ts > 36h -> auto-assign to regional AE and add note. If claim.status==pending and >7d -> orphan and partnership team notified.
claims-bot: claim-service: event=auto_assign acct=ACCT-2345 -> assigned=us-west-ae-21 reason=36h-stale
Maria Chen: Good. Also require partner to set a `credit_intent` field at claim time: values=[demo, referral, co-sell]. That helps billing attribution.
Tia Gomez: Auditability request: show full event timeline in Confluence entry or the CRM ticket. I need to be able to pull "who did what" for any disputed account.
Arun Desai: We'll surface `audit_log_url` on the claim object that links to the internal timeline view; it will include actor, timestamp, action, payload.
Laila Nguyen: One more: marketplace UI should show badge `claimed-by: <partner>` and `demo_hold` indicator so partners and customers see the state.
Samir Patel: I'll add the UI flags and a lightweight badge. Also recommending a small in-UI CTA: "Request release" which triggers a claim_release workflow and emails prior owner.
Maria Chen: Action recap: (1) Arun - build webhook + CSV dump + audit_log_url (EOD Thu); (2) Samir - add auto-assign timers (36h/7d), UI badge, release flow (end of week); (3) Laila - define evidence rules for SI credit and write the short template for meeting notes; (4) Tia - prepare reconciliation checklist and run first CSV after webhook ready.
Tia Gomez: Timeline OK. Please include sample payloads so I can validate CSV columns.
Arun Desai: Will post sample payloads here by tomorrow noon.
claims-bot: claim-service: webhook_registered url=https://hooks.redwood/internal/claims/sync status=ok
Maria Chen: Thanks team. If we get these in place before marketing publishes the listing, we avoid credit disputes and reduce support noise. I'll paste the Confluence link once the doc is live. :spiral_calendar:
